title: Correct wildcard and nil identity instance assessment
api_or_output: Correct effective attribute and nilled identity field assessment through existing frozen hooks

acceptance.description: Reproduce unchanged original attZ002.v: prohibited attribute bindings contribute no positive instance use; permit assessment through a matching wildcard. Preserve rejection without matching wildcard, strict missing-declaration behavior, matching global datatype/fixed checks, local-use precedence and missing default behavior.

Reproduce unchanged original idF018.i: a valid nilled identity field must still have a simple effective type or complex type with simple content. Reject anyType/element-only fields before tuple qualification; preserve unique nil exemption, key/nillable rejection, effective xsi:type and shared charged cancellation/budget behavior.

Pass exact original baselines and repaired outcomes plus independently specified neighbors, affected evaluator/identity/facade checks, public1417 and frozen APIs, normal/true XML-only consumers, planning validation and bounded actual allocation evidence; no API change or later milestone dependency.

handoff.summary: Read-only source/Second Edition review confirms both original corpus defects. Claim after a worker slot is released; no competing source owner.
